notes: Reviewed 2026-11-15: growth phase of 27 samples taken from the submitters own growth-phase field in the duplicate deposit GSE94117 (3-8 h exponential, 24 and 48 h stationary, 168 and 336 h late stationary) | Time course in glucose-limited DM500 without OD or phase words. growth_phase only from the overnight rule: 24 h stationary, 48/168/336 h late_stationary (inferred); 3-8 h left empty. treatment carbon_starvation only for 24 h and later (glucose exhaustion in glucose-limited medium, the study's 'starvation'); 3-8 h left empty because the text does not say when glucose ran out; exposure not given. No control condition identified (pure time course), is_control left out. Libraries: fragmented total RNA in a small-RNA kit with >100 bp inserts gel-selected, treated as total_rnaseq; the -ND samples were not rRNA depleted. WT re-read: unmodified REL606, so wild_type. | 2026-11-20: treatment of the 24 h and later samples set to none. Glucose running out in a glucose-limited batch culture is ordinary entry into stationary phase, which growth_phase already records; carbon_starvation is kept for cells deliberately shifted to medium without a carbon source. | 2026-11-20: 168 h and 336 h moved from late_stationary to the new value long_term_stationary (more than 72 h); 48 h stays late_stationary where no phase is stated.
